info.title: Cisco IOS-XE IETF - ietf-diffserv-classifier
info.description:
IETF standard data from `ietf-diffserv-classifier` module.

**Root containers:** 1 (classifiers)
**Paths:** 11 | **Operations:** 44

Supports CRUD for read-write nodes, GET for read-only nodes.

get.description:

This deletes the resource and all descendant data.
